title: Six-panel storyboard
prompt:

[Layout (must be followed strictly)]
- Exactly 6 storyboard panels, **of equal width**, arranged in **a single horizontal row (1 row × 6 columns)**; not a grid, not two rows, and never split any panel into upper and lower parts.
- Each panel is a **tall vertical rectangle** (height clearly greater than width, close to a 9:16 vertical strip).
- Numbered 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 from left to right, with a circular number badge in the top-left corner of each panel; **each number appears only once — no repeats, no skipped numbers, no missing numbers.**
- **Every panel must show the character herself** performing that panel's action; the character is the main subject of the panel, complete and clear (half-body or full-body, taking up about 2/3 or more of the panel height); **empty panels with only background and no person are strictly forbidden.**

[Character] Use the input reference image (including a facial close-up and a front/side/back full-body turnaround) as the character design baseline: a modern young woman with long brown wavy hair and airy see-through bangs, fresh clear makeup, wearing a pink square-neck fitted long-sleeve knit top, a brown corduroy over-the-knee skirt with a brown leather belt, and brown leather biker boots. Every panel shows the same person — face, hairstyle, outfit and body proportions stay consistent; only pose, expression, action and setting change. The reference image only defines appearance; do not copy its standing pose. Blend the character naturally into each real-world scene, with correct perspective and scale and matching lighting.

[Panel-by-panel scenes and content]
Panel 1: A modern minimalist apartment with early-morning sunlight streaming in; the girl stands by the floor-to-ceiling window holding a mug in both hands, gazing out at the city skyline, with a calm expression.
Panel 2: A busy city-street sidewalk in daytime, lined with fashionable shop windows and plane trees; the girl carries a shoulder bag and glances back slightly while walking, with a faint smile.
Panel 3: A window booth in an artsy, fresh café; the girl sits looking down at her phone, smiling, with soft light from the window and a latte on the table.
Panel 4: A bookshelf aisle in a warm-toned independent bookstore; the girl stands on tiptoe pulling a book from the shelf, her profile focused, the light gentle.
Panel 5: A city pedestrian overpass under the golden glow of the evening sunset; the girl leans on the railing and looks back, with blurred traffic and high-rises in the background and warm light falling on her face.
Panel 6: A street corner lit by neon at night; the girl looks up, smiling ahead, surrounded by warm yellow streetlights and bokeh light spots, in an urban night atmosphere.
